full_name: Namita Dharia | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Radcliffe Institute Graduate Student Fellow Harvard University
bio: Namita Dharia is a doctoral candidate in the Department of Anthropology at Harvard University. Her research interests include architecture and the built environment, urban development politics, labor, and the experience of cities.
